purpose: Document first-party municipal discovery and bounded anonymous cadastral/map-service review for Caxias do Sul, Rio Grande do Sul, Brazil.
assessment: The official municipal DIGEO/GeoCaxias portal and ArcGIS Cadastro_Territorial service evidence a local cadastral custodian. Service metadata identifies a Lotes polygon layer (ID 3), EPSG:31982, and public JSON/GeoJSON support. The exact-point anonymous query timed out, so no parcel hit or absence inference is made.
registryAssessment: registryFound=true because the municipal cadastral custodian, local cadastral office, and public territorial map service are directly evidenced. This is not evidence of citywide completeness or adapter admission.

officialPrimarySources.observation: Official DIGEO page identifies GeoCaxias, the municipal geospatial-data portal, and the Gerência de Cadastro Técnico Multifinalitário, which registers municipal properties and relates tax data to the cadastral map.
Official service page documents municipal cadastral registration and says approved areas are entered into the municipal cadastro multifinalitário and GeoCaxias.
Official ArcGIS REST service metadata names Cadastro Territorial, publishes EPSG:31982, and lists Lotes, Quadras, Sublotes, and related municipal layers with JSON/GeoJSON support.
Official Lotes layer metadata identifies polygon geometry, public query support, native EPSG:31982, and the layer display field inscricaoloteponto. Unsafe source attributes were not retained.
